messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: router-service p99 latency breach in us-west-2 (>5s). Streaming stalls observed on /v1/stream endpoints. Trigger: latency-slo-breach. Paging oncall. Please ack and triage. :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: acked. i'm on it. alex (oncall) here. what's current p95/p99? any obvious errors in logs?

sre-lee: p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~5.4s from synthetic. telemetry shows a spike starting 05:09 UTC. router queuing depth shot up on a subset of shards, tail is dominated by misrouted streaming requests hitting overloaded backends.

eng-runtime-maya: i see a rolling release of router-routing-policy v1.8.2 that started ~05:05 UTC. that build changed `sticky_evaporation_thresh` default from 0.5 -> 0.3 and altered egress weights in multi-zone balancer. suspect policy bug causing hot partitioning on certain hashing salt seeds.

oncall-alex: can we snapshot the hot shard and identify keys? how big is the blast radius (customer count / routes)?

sre-lee: quick local dump shows hot shard id sha1:ab12cdef... queue depth ~420, while typical ~20. affected routes: /v1/stream/chat and /v1/generate/stream. roughly 3% of traffic but responsible for ~60% of p99s.

eng-runtime-maya: recommend immediate rollback to routing-policy v1.8.1 and disable region_affinity for streaming routes as a short-term mitigation. i'll prepare rollback command.

eng-runtime-maya: executing rollback now: `redwood-routerctl deploy --policy v1.8.1 --region usw2 --force`

infra-jordan: i'm increasing capacity on the dedicated pool for us-west-2 (scale +2 nodes) and bumping streaming route max inflight from 200 -> 400 to absorb bursts. doing now.

sre-lee: applying emergency config to turn off region affinity for streaming routes: `POST /api/config/routing {"streaming":{"region_affinity":false}}` (pushed).

oncall-alex: rolling rollback command completed (returned 200). watching metrics.

incident-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE: routing policy rollback v1.8.1 applied by eng-runtime-maya at 05:16 UTC. region_affinity disabled for streaming routes.

sre-lee: after rollback + capacity bump: synthetic checks show p95 700ms, p99 1.3s for router-service in us-west-2. streaming stalls reduced, no new stall alerts in last 90s.

eng-runtime-maya: logs snippet (tail):
```
[05:14:52] router: route=/v1/stream chat_id=sha1:ab12cdef queue_depth=18 backend_latency=120ms
[05:15:12] router: route=/v1/stream chat_id=sha1:ab12cdef queue_depth=12 backend_latency=110ms
[05:15:32] router: route=/v1/stream chat_id=sha1:ab12cdef queue_depth=6 backend_latency=95ms
```

prod-sam: customer impact: CS reports two customers saw streaming timeouts between 05:09-05:18 UTC. tickets 8675, 8676 opened. linking monitoring to the tickets.

cust-success-anna: contacting customers now with a short incident note and ETA ~30m for postmortem. will update once they respond.

sre-lee: additional mitigation: evict the hot key from prefix cache to avoid replays causing hotness. command: `redwood-cache evict --key sha1:ab12cdef --prefix route:/v1/stream` (done).

eng-runtime-maya: also rolling a small hash-salt tweak to avoid immediate re-hotsharding: `redwood-routerctl config set hashing.salt=0x9f` (applied).

infra-jordan: dedicated pool nodes added and healthy. autoscaler muted for 10m to avoid thrash.

oncall-alex: monitoring APM traces for any residual tail. will keep this thread open for handoff.

sre-lee: next steps: 1) run deeper trace sampling on affected shard for root cause, 2) run post-rollback load test, 3) plan a patch for v1.8.2 policy bug (sticky_evaporation edge-case). assigning to eng-runtime.

eng-runtime-maya: i have a draft repro and will open a tracking issue with logs/traces (link pasted to the incident board). I'll also add a unit test for sticky_evaporation boundary.

prod-sam: scheduling a short customer-facing blurb once we have final impact numbers.

cust-success-anna: confirmed both affected customers acknowledged the message, no immediate escalation.

oncall-alex: handing off monitoring and follow-up to lee (sre). alex off-shift in 12m. leave any runbook changes in the /runbooks/router-hotkeys doc.

sre-lee: ack. i'll take over and run the deeper triage. leaving this thread open; will update with the postmortem link and timeline once ready. :white_check_mark:
